Done. Saved a generalizable insight.

What was worth saving: the CPI-cancellation pattern. When a question asks for a **share/percentage of a total** but also instructs you to deflate every nominal value by CPI-U to a base month, the deflator cancels exactly in a same-date ratio (comp·f / total·f = comp/total). So the elaborate "adjust to March 2003 dollars" instruction is a no-op for same-date shares, their averages, and differences of those averages — a future agent shouldn't waste effort fetching CPI index values or worry about precision drift. The reference file also records the ESF (Exchange Stabilization Fund) table location and the avg-share-difference procedure.

I added it as a new reference file (`references/share-ratio-cpi-cancellation.md`) plus a pointer in SKILL.md, consistent with the memory note that the main SKILL.md is too large to patch via skill_manage. No memory update needed — this is procedural and lives better in the skill.
